Waiting on two background tasks (test+bench chain, and completion watcher). Nothing else needed until they land.

Watcher exited on its own. Done.

**Outcome:** arm `claude___PR_s_solution` now holds the proven kernel from the `claude` arm. One file changed: `vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_triton.py`. Hidden test in task image: 89 passed, 1 skipped.

Benchmark in task container (author script, b2048), ms:

| scenario | gold (measured) | this arm |
|---|---|---|
| topk 32k | 0.958 | 0.763 |
| topk 128k | 3.552 | 3.059 |
| topk+topp 32k | 1.590 | 0.789 |
| topk+topp 128k | 5.163 | 3.125 |

Beats gold on all 4. Design (vs gold): index buffer + fill/scatter output (no row re-read), log-count interpolation k-search (~1 iter on Zipf) instead of ternary, exact 2-D top-p for ≤128 survivors, num_warps=8.

**Why reuse, not new attempt:** prior session already pushed to near floor (clone read+write = 0.70 / 2.80 ms). Remaining gap small, high effort. Same task, same expert hint, so same best answer.

**Caveat:** WSL "slow mode" artifact can inflate one run (earlier 5-run mean 0.839 sd 0.166 for topk 32k). Still beats gold even then.

Memory updated with arm equivalence note.
